summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A. (formerly Centrais Elétricas Brasileiras S.A. - Eletrobrás) solely to announce a change in the disclosure date of its Form 20-F from April 17 to April 24, 2026. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed. The filing is a routine administrative update with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics. The V.P. of Finance and Investor Relations signed the report. There is no event to watch or risk-arb angle.
